items.title: Why Females Prefer Warmer Rooms
items.snippet: Why do women generally prefer the thermostat set higher than men? Researchers at King’s College London discovered that two thermosensitive ion channels, TRPM2 and TRPM8, are molecularly tuned to activate at warmer temperatures in females, resolving a long-standing biological debate.

items.title: CTE Affected 75% of Deceased NFL Veterans
items.snippet: How common is CTE among professional football players? A new study corrects for brain donation selection bias, estimating that 74.5% of all NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 had chronic traumatic encephalopathy.

items.title: Six popular sugar substitutes linked to faster brain aging

items.snippet: Getting more daylight could be linked to a surprisingly powerful benefit for brain health. items.title: A single brain signal may explain schizophrenia's most puzzling symptoms
items.snippet: Scientists have identified a weakened brain signal that may connect several seemingly unrelated symptoms of schizophrenia, including sensory processing difficulties, disorganized speech, and greater symptom severity. The surprising discovery could help explain the disorder's underlying mechanisms and potentially lead to earlier detection and new treatments.
